main_text.l: tum facientibus, collata. Prius ex Mose desumptum,
exhibet nobis canticum, Deo dictante a Viro Dei exce-
ptum, atque in cynosuram omnium prophetiarum
sequentium populo Dei traditum, quo viarum Dei,
circa Ecclesiam servandarum, teneat compendium,
atque articulorum doctrinae propheticae rudimen-
tum. Hujus meditatio Davidi ejusque in poësi sacra
coöperariis, saepè materiam praebuit, pluribus
sermonibus amplificandam, & pigmentis poeticis or-
nandam: Prophetis autem varia argumenta (prout
temporum ferebat ratio) Spiritu eos incitante pe-
nitius inquirenda, novisque circumstantiis (ex no-
vis revelationibus haustis) investienda. Alterum
adjeci specimen, ex minorum Prophetarum volu-
mine assumptum; librum nempe HABAKUKI; quo
illustremus Prophetarum sequentium methodum,
utque illi spem, ex divino hoc cantico conceptam,
novis visionum enarrationibus concionibusque,
sub certis tentationibus vacillantem, erexerint,
& fata populi, in priori delineata, quando opus erat,
novo lumine exposuerint: omnia suis accommo-
dantes consiliis, & pro variatione tentationis, nec
non rerum exigentia, applicantes.
Haec dum molior, adversus obnitentium pra-
evisa studia me confirmant dicta Petri, 2 Petr. 1:
19-21. quibus Propheticam Scripturam ab utilitate
suâ peculiari commendaturus, in hunc modum
scribit.

page.notes: Small specks and stains on the scan are not printed text and are left out. The word "sequentiumt" has a faint mark after it; read as "sequentium". The spacing in "exhibet nobis" and "Mose desumptum" is hard to judge on the scan. The long s appears as f in "desumptum" and "investienda" and is transcribed as s. The reference "2 Petr. 1: 19-21." is copied as printed.
